title: Samuel Thompson
repository: Delaware Native American Archives / Mitsawokett Collection
transcriber: Archival Transcriber / Written in the Genome
citation: "Samuel Thompson." Historical Document Record (2006). Preserved in the Nanticoke & Moor Historical Archive (Written in the Genome Collection).
lines: Samuel Thompson Jr., father, grandfather, brother, uncle and friend, departed this life on Tuesday, April 11, 2006, at home. He was born in Lewes, Delaware on September 27, 1930, a son of the late Samuel and Martha Thompson. In 1959 he met the late Annabelle Joynes; they married. He is survived by his brother Howdie Thompson of Millsboro; a sister, Pearl Davis of Dover; sons William Harvey (Una), David Thompson (Daisey), Bradley Thompson (Patria), Wydell Thompson, Donnell Thompson and Douglas Thompson (Robbin), all of Millsboro; daughters Mary Cross (Herman) of Salisbury, Maryland and Shirley Thompson (Tracy) of Rehoboth Beach; 25 grandchildren and 27 great-grandchildren. He was preceded in death by his wife Annabelle Thompson and a son, Gerald Lee Thompson. Transcribed from the program's script face; the sons' list as printed also carries the name Deroy Thompson of Bridgeville.
